posts.name: Chaosmancer
posts.cooked:
There was a lot of really good stuff in there. I have some white text spoilers at the end, but a few other things.

 

I think I would be a reader who would understand poor Benchmark. The guy just comes across as clueless to me, and so I don't think he would have annoyed me very much. I mean, his heart is in the right place, he just doesn't "get it".

 

I'm looking forward to seeing him in action, but I can't help but feel his deck is going to be a "polished version of Bunker" type of thing. It appeals to me under those circumstances, but that's just the sensation I get from hearing about him.

 

Man, I seriously want these hero decks to show up at my door. Anybody finish their time machine yet and willing to help a guy out?

 

Holy Crap Vyktor!!

posts.name: Phantom5613
posts.cooked:
To draw a crude comparison with no exprience with Benchmark, I'll hazard a guess that: Bunker and Benchmark are similar to War Machine and Iron Man respectivley.

Bunker and War Machine are military tacticians, both in heavy-duty suits with hard armaments.

Benchmark and Iron Man are privelaged pretty-boys that have highly modular armors that specialize in energy blasts and have a slew of tools for multiple situations.

Very generalized comparisons, but that's what I can draw with what information I have.
